'''Adar 2 (April 14)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{Ne|979}} - [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Siuan Sanche]] visit the [[Aesdaishar Palace]]. Moiraine learns [[Lan Mandragoran]]'s title and heritage.
*{{Ne|998}} - Proclamation from [[Illian]] of the [[The Great Hunt of the Horn]] is read in [[Whitebridge]].
*{{Ne|999}} - [[Perrin Aybara]]'s party pass through the villages of [[Samaha]] (where the wells have gone dry), [[Tallan]] (where there have been many arguments and three murders), and [[Fyall]] (where the mayor has found gold from [[Manetheren]]).
